title: Theft at the Market
description: Somebody cleared out half a stall at the Mill Brook market two nights back. The merchant has a guess who, and a guess is not proof - accusing the wrong neighbour in a hamlet this size costs him more custom than the goods were worth. He wants someone found who actually saw something.

objectives.description: Question the witness before you go accusing anybody

notes: Threat: theft from a market stall the merchant can't afford to lose again. Giver motive: trade politics - a wrong accusation against a neighbor costs more than the goods. Consequence of refusal: unwired - he keeps guessing and keeps quiet about it.
